blocks.body: Low, protective, ready to retreat if retreat becomes safer than warning.

affordances: Give it distance before deciding it is hostile.

handouts.kicker: A real village under corporate designation, protected by ward pillars.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Hush is warm before it is safe: low roofs, clover smoke, hand-repaired doors, and ward posts humming just a little off-key.

blocks.body: Moss softens every lane until your footsteps go quiet, so you hear the canals first, then laundry snapping on a line, then a hundred small repairs underway at once. Doors hang a little crooked and patched with obvious care. On the ward posts at the water...

handouts.hook: An ancient forest logistics preserve where colossal trees, hybrid fauna, underroot communities, route tolls, and corporate liability language all compete to define what safety means.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Sablewood is an ancient forest forced to wear a logistics badge: colossal trunks, liability signs, toll language, and living routes that do not care about forms.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The trees go up until the sky closes over, and the light that reaches the road is green and always moving. A vest-badge nailed to a trunk reads Sablewood Logistics Preserve, and a hundred yards on the same kind of trunk has swallowed an older sign whole...
